name: Mother Ignoring Kid Drowning In A Pool
meaning: A mother happily plays with one child while another child struggles in the water; below, a skeleton sits at the bottom of the pool. For focusing on something new while neglecting the old thing, and the long-forgotten one.
when_to_use: text3 = who is giving attention (the mother, right). text2 = the new favorite (the happy child). text1 = the neglected one (the struggling child, left). text4 = the long-forgotten one (the skeleton, bottom panel).
